description: This file defines types, interfaces, and a store interface for managing conversations in a Microsoft Teams bot environment, supporting proactive messaging functionality.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a conversation reference for a given conversation ID in the store.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a conversation entry by conversation ID.

methods.name: findPreferredDmByUserId
methods.description: Finds the most recent direct message conversation for a user, used for proactive user-targeted messages.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Legacy method to find a conversation by user ID, deprecated in favor of `findPreferredDmByUserId`.
